title: ListBox
description: House react-aria ListBox with two settings chosen by the root's variant: inline rows in the document flow (the tenant switcher) and popover rows inside a Select's anchored list, where a bloom wash marks focus and a needle wash marks selection with no ring.

anatomy.description: react-aria ListBox root with data-slot="listbox" and data-variant="inline" | "popover". Owns gap, inset, the 16rem scroll cap and the thin bark scrollbar of the popover setting.
react-aria ListBoxItem with data-slot="listbox-item". Styled through the root's variant, so an item needs no prop; extend with className for row content such as a trailing hint.

usage: Pass variant on the root only: inline for a list rendered in place (inline over overlay, component-architecture §4.2), popover when the list sits in a Select or other anchored picker.

Popover rows draw no focus ring; the bloom row wash is the focus indicator and the ring stays on the trigger (theming §4.4 exception). Inline rows keep the ring because nothing else marks focus there.
Focus and hover answer in bloom, selection in needle, and a row that is both mixes the two washes with color-mix (theming §4.7).
Keyboard navigation, typeahead and selection semantics come from react-aria; never reimplement them on the items.
Promotion precedent: this was the tenant switcher's private descendant until Select became its second, unrelated consumer.
